module: Scenario end and start routes (Vue, abstract module): start, end, quickrace.end and chapter.end. Each screen has an action scopeTree with backTarget to the root; conditional blocks (settings, progress, vehicle, rewards, stats, mission) are `optional = true` for the scope validator. Default back to pause.
notes: Route configuration module: it exports no function. routeManager reads it (via the ui_router_routes_<name> extension) when routes.lua includes it with `{ include = "<name>" }`.
The keys of `Children` form the segments of the dotted name: "<module>.<child>". `children` (lowercase) in a node designates its sub-routes; `include` mounts another module there.
`ui` is inherited by child routes (uiTypes, uiTypesFilter, infoBar, topBar, uiApps, uiNav, triggerPause): a child redefines it only for what changes.

Root.desc: {abstract = true, ui = filter only, infoBar and topBar hidden, uiApps visible}

Children.desc: start, end, quickrace (abstract > end), chapter (abstract > end); screenId scenario.start / scenario.end / scenario.quickrace.end / scenario.chapter.end, all Vue with backTarget = "pause".

ModuleName.desc: Name of the routes module (first segment of the dotted name).
